summary: Entra Policy Suite now holds Exchange rights only when a feature you use needs them.

new.title: Exchange rights only when needed
new.text: Exchange Online rights are granted only while user tagging, the Identity report or a mailbox rule is on. Running the install removes them when none is on.

new.title: Clearer Exchange setup step
new.text: The Exchange setup step now says whether it is needed and how to grant or remove it.
